name: phenanthrene
spin_convention: spin=N_alpha-N_beta=2*M_s for the collinear seed; this does not constrain a general spinor SCF to an S^2 eigenstate.
atom_string_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 exact atom string; no trailing newline

expected_dimensions.status: Algebraic expectations from archived Cartesian basis shells and integer occupations; must be asserted against runtime arrays.
expected_dimensions.full_response_operator_dimension: 2 * transition_dimension for the full X/Y response formulation; TDA has transition_dimension only.
assumptions: all occupied and all virtual orbitals retained
GKS occupations are 0 or 1; UKS blocks have 0 or 1; RKS has 0 or 2
nroots is a runtime solver request, not an orbital-window truncation

grid_policy: Level 3 in SCF and all response kernels; record actual points/weights/order/pruning and verify shared quadrature. Grid level alone is not a numerical equivalence certificate.
representation_policy: Select RKS/UKS/GKS explicitly at runtime. UKS spin-conserving blocks do not establish whole-spinor GKS support. Do not silently replace full TDDFT/BSE by TDA.
result_status: Input metadata only; no SCF, GW, BSE, TDDFT, optimization, or numerical validation performed by fixture preparation.
geometry_role: Archived neutral PubChem 995 computed 3D conformer, unchanged. Fixed-nuclei paired benchmark; no quantum-optimized neutral or cation geometry claimed.
benchmark_role: Neutral/cation paired fixed-geometry vertical response and capacity benchmark; no adiabatic gap, 0-0 band, or experimental spectrum equivalence claimed.
ri_scope: Fixed weigend auxiliary basis for reproducible RI capacity comparison; no orbital-basis or RI-basis convergence claim.
